name: avalanchetrust
description: Trustless AVAX escrow on the Avalanche C-Chain. contracts (Foundry), frontend (Next.js), backend (metadata API).

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix backend run test
scripts.contracts:deploy:fuji: cd contracts && forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url fuji --broadcast --verify -vvv
scripts.contracts:deploy:mainnet: cd contracts && forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url avalanche --broadcast --verify -vvv
